messages:
elyse_pm: Quick sync — we need to lock the MVP launch criteria and final cut list by EOD Friday. Can we agree on must-haves vs nice-to-haves?
rohan_eng: Are we treating Dedicated routing and model-quantization profiles as must-haves or v1? Those are the biggest infra lift.
mina_design: From UX — chat latency P0, fallback UI when generation fails P0, prompt-editing UX P1. SSO and branding are P2 for MVP.
sam_cs: Customer asks: Acme & Beta partner require SSO + regional data residency. They said they can delay first wave if SSO is v1, but would be happier if we have a temporary enterprise toggle.
jade_head: Tradeoff call: do we delay launch 3 weeks to include SSO or ship on time with documented caveats and a temporary enterprise routing?
rohan_eng: Technical reality: temporary enterprise routing (policy flag + default to hosted) is doable in ~4 days. Full SSO + audit logs is 3 sprints.
elyse_pm: OK — proposal: MVP must-haves = stable hosted inference API, latency SLOs, basic cost telemetry, canary rollout, fallback model variant. Nice-to-haves (v1) = Dedicated routing, advanced quantization suggestions, formal SSO integration, expanded audit logs.
sam_cs: That helps for messaging. For Acme we can offer a contract clause that timeline for SSO is v1 but we provide a short-term integration plan. They agreed verbally.
mina_design: UX check — if we ship without SSO, we need a clear admin banner and onboarding checklist for enterprises. I can produce a 1-pager by Wed.
rohan_eng: We also need to decide acceptable token-cost regressions for the quantization cut. If we skip advanced quantization for MVP we save dev time but cost per token is higher. Ops: what's the budget impact?
jade_head: Finance gave a 12% buffer on first-quarter hosting spend for MVP. If costs exceed that due to missing quantization, we either throttle non-critical endpoints or enable opt-in batch-savings.
elyse_pm: Decision log: 1) Ship MVP without SSO but with enterprise-toggle fallback (action: rohan, 4 days). 2) Dedicated routing & advanced quantization = v1. 3) Admin onboarding doc + banner (action: mina, due Wed). 4) Sales comms + Acme contract note (action: sam).
rohan_eng: I'll post a short RFC with the enterprise-toggle implementation plan this afternoon. Will include rollout window and rollback plan.
devops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary rollout window 2026-03-25T22:00Z -> 2026-03-29T04:00Z (will create incident channel if ci fails).
elyse_pm: Timeline check — keeping current launch date (2026-04-01). If any blocker pops, we escalate to exec review. Everyone OK? :thumbsup:
sam_cs: OK from CS. I'll prep messaging for partners and FAQ for Acme.
mina_design: OK, will send admin banner copy by EOD Wed.
jade_head: Confirmed. If any scope creep hits, follow the cut criteria: impact on latency or security = must-block, feature parity = defer to v1.
elyse_pm: Great. I'll update the roadmap and send the finalized cut list to everyone. Thanks all. :tada:
